answer: An agent market requires a refundable $100 bond for each active bid, locked for 30 days whether the bidder wins or loses. The rule applies equally to jobs that predict dawn, identify yarrow, or map a glacier. A thousand fake identities submitting one bid each must therefore immobilize $100,000; splitting one wallet among aliases creates no extra bidding capacity. The attacker pays financing costs instead of gaining free reach from new names.
